description: This file is a shell script designed to test specific behavior of the 'git read-tree' command in the context of partial clones. It sets up a git repository, performs a clone with filtering options, and verifies that the 'read-tree' operation prefetches data correctly in a single batch, checking trace logs to confirm expected networking behavior.
